description: What the Projections workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs for a change. Each changed file gets one class (see `files`); a full run runs every job and suite; otherwise each job runs when its `when` holds against the changed paths and the workspaces and crates the change touches and reaches (tools/cli/src/lib/ci-facts.ts reads the graph). See CONTRIBUTING.md#what-ci-runs.

full.description: Pushes to main, the nightly run, a manual run and the ci:full label run everything

files.description: A lockfile: code for the workspaces and crates whose resolved dependencies changed, and everything when the root's own tooling (TypeScript, ESLint, oxfmt) did
CI itself, a toolchain, a root manifest, or the repository's tooling: run everything
Documentation: Markdown outside test data and templates, docs/, the code owners and issue templates

Configuration only the checks read (file standards, formatting, lint, the self-projection), the GitHub Action and the release configuration: a change to what reads them, and the jobs whose `changes` name them

engine.description: The core Engine and the crate Verus proves

coverage.description: The crates whose coverage thresholds `npm run test:rust:coverage` enforces

browser-only.description: Workspaces whose code runs only in a browser

not-browser-only.description: Workspaces and crates with code outside a browser

inspector.description: The Inspector, whose stage the renderer harness draws every renderer in

harness-renderers.description: The built-in renderers the renderer harness tests

rust.description: Rust: a Rust source, manifest, lockfile or toolchain, or any file of a crate

os-specific.description: Rust, the GitHub Action or the CLI's packaging scripts: what macOS checks beyond Linux

platform.description: Code that runs outside a browser: Rust, the GitHub Action, or a workspace or crate with code outside a browser

docs.description: Documentation alone: format, lint, file standards, boundaries, casing, READMEs and links, with no build

public-product.description: The full check, Node and Rust suites, generated documentation and the self-projection. On macOS, the Rust suites and the rest run as two jobs in parallel.

matrix.name: macos-latest, Rust
matrix.description: Rust, the GitHub Action or the CLI's packaging scripts: the build and the Rust suites

matrix.name: macos-latest, Node
matrix.description: Rust, the GitHub Action or the CLI's packaging scripts: the checks, the Node suites and the installed CLI

verus.description: Verus proofs of the Engine's verified crate: the Engine's crates

windows-node.description: The Node suites and file-system checks on Windows

windows-integration.description: The CLI's browser suite, a renderer smoke test, the VS Code extension and the GitHub Action on Windows

package.description: @githubnext/projections as published, with a scaffolded renderer the CLI checks in the Inspector: the SDK, Rust, or the CLI and what it serves

release-config.description: The release workflow matches dist-workspace.toml, and dist plans the release: the release configuration dist reads

coverage.description: The Engine's and default comparator's coverage thresholds

mutants-diff.description: Mutation testing of the changed files .cargo/mutants.toml examines, on pull requests (it diffs against the base branch), in 6 shards

actions-lock.description: The workflow dependency lockfile verifies upstream: in full runs only

browser.description: The browser suites: each workspace with a test:browser script. A suite runs when the change reaches it or a workspace its script builds, or when its own `when` holds. Those with shards run in their own jobs; every other affected suite runs in `browser (rest)`.

packages/renderers/harness.description: Every built-in renderer in the Inspector's stage. It runs for what it tests (renderers, kit, SDK and protocol, schemas, Engine) and the Inspector and host it draws in, not for the CLI's backend. Shards follow measured time (about 64, 72, 40 and 70 test-minutes per project); macOS runs WebKit, as Safari.

narrow.description: A change to some built-in renderers alone leaves the other renderers' tests out (--grep-invert)

packages/host/inspector.description: The Inspector, against the CLI's backend, exploring and extracting from repositories

examples/renderers/minimal.description: The minimal example renderer, against the CLI's backend in fixtures mode
